concept.title: Tasklytics API Overview
concept.shortdesc: The Tasklytics API lets you create, read, update, and delete tasks programmatically using standard HTTP requests.

conbody.p: The Tasklytics API follows REST conventions. Every resource is accessed through a URL called an endpoint. You send HTTP requests to those endpoints — GET to read data, POST to create it, PUT to update it, and DELETE to remove it. The API returns responses in JSON format.
All requests must include your API key in the Authorization header. Requests that do not include a valid key receive a 401 Unauthorized response.
